question: In which tear was Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi killed in battle?
solution:
The correct answer is "**1858**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rani Laxmibai, the Rani of Jhansi, passed away on **June 18**, **1858**, while battling the British at **Gwalior**.
 
• She played a key role in the **1857** Indian Revolt.
 
• She became a role model for the Indian freedom movement after her sacrifice.
 
• She symbolizes both women's empowerment and national pride.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On **November 19,1835**, Manikarnika Tambe, a Marathi woman, was born in **Varanasi** who is known as Rani Laxmibai.
 
• Her parents were **Bhagirathi Bai** and **Moropant Tambe**. Morapant was working in Bithoor in the **Peshwa’s court**.
 
• She was a relative of** Nana Sahib**, the adopted son of the exiled **Peshwa Baji Rao II**.
 
• Rani Laxmibai had **Nana Sahib** and **Tatya Tope** as her childhood friends.
 
• Her education was taken care of by the **Peshwa** who ensured that she was also trained in **shooting, fencing and horse riding**.
 
• When she turned 7, Manikarnika Tambe was married to **Gangadhar Rao**, who was the **King of Jhansi**.
 
• She was renamed **Laxmibai** after marriage.
